entries.evidence: Span fraction 0.228 vs 0.232 reference; wing chord vs fuselage width is plausible; float length is about 0.8 of fuselage length which is right for a Beaver.

entries.evidence: Windows are dark blue-grey with a slight lighter reflection band, no interior visible; window frames are drawn; no opaque or flickering glass across the clip.
entries.defect: Glass is uniformly dark, no sky reflection gradient across the windscreen at G6.

entries.evidence: Main skyline reads as a plausible cluster of 20-30 towers with haze; the right island city at G3-H3 is a set of flat pastel boxes (pink, mint, lavender) with no window texture or facade breakup even though it is only ~4 km away; the mainland beyond the skyline is a texture-less pale mint plane.

entries.evidence: Yellow paint with rivets, panel lines and sharp decals, but the surface is fully matte: no sun highlight, no clearcoat sky reflection on the white upper fuselage, max fuselage value 175/255; the decal mixes a light serif BAHÍA VISTA with a bold AIR TAXI.
entries.defect: Matte paint with no highlight under direct sun.
entries.fix: Add clearcoat/roughness 0.15 with the sun GGX term; unify the decal typeface.

entries.condition: cabin glass in direct 15:30 sun, glass region max RGB 223, no pixels >250
entries.evidence: Panes are transparent with the pilot, seats and far-side windows visible through them, which is correct for transmission; there is no Fresnel or sun reflection on any pane in a frame designed to test glass under sun, so the windows read as open holes; the aft window at F3 is a dark grey opaque flat pane set into a curved fuselage.
entries.defect: No reflection on glass in sun; opaque aft window.
entries.fix: Glass material with Fresnel, sun GGX highlight and environment reflection; same material for the aft window.

entries.condition: skyline and causeway behind the wing
entries.evidence: Pastel tower cluster with an arch bridge and tree blobs plus a causeway with container row; towers are flat colour slabs without window rows.
entries.fix: Add window texture at mid LOD.

entries.evidence: Island with sand rim and tree blobs beyond the strut; clean horizon.

entries.fix: Add fine normal cascade for near view.

entries.evidence: Faint reflection streaks under the floats; the white upper fuselage shows a subtle horizontal gradient but no sky or water reflection; the far-side windows show water through them correctly.
entries.defect: No environment reflection on paint or glass.
entries.fix: Environment probe on clearcoat and glass.

entries.evidence: Floats sit on the surface with no waterline or ripple at 3.5 kn; a small distant boat at F3 has a wake.
entries.fix: Emit V wake when onWater and speed >1 kn.

entries.evidence: Round tree blobs of varied size along the shore; acceptable at 1.5 km; no palms.
